verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation describes a real-time GPU availability view, API, or CLI query by GPU type and region before provisioning. The '30+ regions' marketing claim and the pricing tables do not show stock levels. One community report mentions 'low availability' messages while deploying, but it is undocumented, does not show availability before provisioning or broken out by region, and the same user says instances sometimes still fail to boot, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
